doc: A float32 field with std 1.0e-4 (mean ~0): small but strictly positive, so the divisor is the std itself and the result has unit variance. It pins the `sd > 0` test to ZERO: a threshold such as 1e-3 would fall back to dividing by 1 and return values of order 1e-4. Default tolerance 1e-5/1e-6: the same float32 statistics as the unit-interval case (measured worst difference 1.8e-7, relative error is scale-free).
